title: Norm of a Rademacher sum
statement: Let $V$ be a real normed vector space, let $w_1,\ldots,w_n\in V$, and let $x=(x_1,\ldots,x_n)\in\{-1,1\}^n$. The Rademacher norm of $w$ at $x$ is the norm of $\sum_{i=1}^n \operatorname{signValue}(x_i)w_i$.
